summary: Verified UI terminology rename (صيدلية/مذخر → متجر/مورد) on the two auth screens and confirmed backend contract (role=pharmacy/supplier) is unchanged. Login screen subtitle now reads 'نظام ذكي للمتاجر والموردين'. Register screen role selector shows exactly 'متجر' (default) and 'مورد'; name label toggles between 'اسم المتجر'/'اسم المورد' with placeholders 'مثال: متجر النور'/'مثال: مورد الأمين'; address label toggles between 'عنوان المتجر'/'عنوان المورد'. Ionicons storefront + business render correctly. /forgot-password shows 'متجر' and 'مورد' role buttons. Regex scan of both files finds ZERO occurrences of old terms (صيدلية / مذخر / مذاخر). Backend sanity: POST /api/pharmacy/register and /api/supplier/register both return 200 with a JWT whose decoded payload role='pharmacy' or 'supplier' respectively; /api/auth/login returns the same roles — backend contract fully intact.

testIDs (role-pharmacy, role-supplier, fp-role-pharmacy, fp-role-supplier, mode-register, input-name, input-address) all present and functional for future regression tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENT NOTE: On starting this iteration the Python venv was corrupted — pydantic_core, cryptography, pypdfium2 and Pillow all had missing .so files, causing backend to crash-loop (public URL returned 502). I fixed by `pip install --force-reinstall` for each affected package (pydantic_core==2.41.5, cryptography, pypdfium2, Pillow). Backend recovered and all endpoints work. This corruption was PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to the terminology change. If it recurs, the same reinstall recipe restores service. Requirements.txt versions were preserved.
